title: On the Spectra of Multiplicative Hilbert Operator on Bergman Spaces of Dirichlet Series
summary: For $α>1$, we study the weighted multiplicative Hilbert operator \[ (T_αf)(s) = \int_{1/2}^{\infty} f(t)\bigl(ζ(s+t)^α-1\bigr) \left(t-\frac12\right)^{α-1}\,dt \] on the Hilbertian Bergman space $A_{α,0}^2$ of Dirichlet series with zero constant term. In the natural orthonormal basis, $T_α$ is represented by the weighted multiplicative Hilbert matrix \[ \left( \frac{Γ(α)\sqrt{d_α(m)d_α(n)}} {\sqrt{mn}\,(\log(mn))^α} \right)_{m,n\ge2}, \] where $d_α$ is the generalized divisor function defined by $ζ(s)^α=\sum_{n\ge1}d_α(n)n^{-s}$ for $\Re s>1$.
